name: Misoji no Douteiriki
source:
"Did you know? If you stay a virgin past the age of 30, you become a sorcerer."
Could this legend really be true!?

Virgin "young" man Ryuichi celebrated his 30th birthday.
Everything he thought was real was turned on its head when his groin suddenly glittered.
It was the Cummoning, and it summoned a beautiful goddess from another realm.

"Hello, Ryuichi-san. I am the Lacasys. You have diligently guarded your precious powers to full strength. Now my world needs your help. Join me..."

Cum all over the ripe tits of adventure! Your epic virginal virginity virgin tale of virgawesome begins!

translation:
“你知道吗？过了30岁还是处男，就会变成魔法师。”
这个传说，难道是真的！？

仍是处男的“年轻”男子龙一，迎来了30岁生日。
当他的胯下突然闪闪发光时，他原本认定的现实，彻底被颠覆了。
那是“射精召唤”，从另一个世界召来了一位美丽的女神。

“你好，龙一先生。我是拉刻西斯。你一直认真守护着珍贵的力量，让它积蓄至巅峰。如今，我的世界需要你的帮助。加入我吧…”

向这场冒险的丰乳尽情射精吧！属于你的、史诗般的童贞奇谭，就此开始！
